no_outcome_promised.note: The draft acknowledges the request for a settlement and for written terms without saying either will be granted. 'Details you need on how to proceed' is neutral.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault or apology conceding error.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: 'Please reply to this message and we'll add it to your enquiry' describes a reply-and-attach process. That process is not in the complaint and may not exist for a web-form submission. Apart from this, only the owning team and the standard 10-business-day timeframe are used.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions.

addresses_each_issue.note: Both questions are restated specifically: who to talk to about settling, and whether the settlement can be put in writing before payment.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful. The encouraging line about the customer's situation is appropriate and not condescending.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode, and the owning team is correctly named.

revision_instructions: Remove or replace the sentence 'In the meantime, if anything changes or you have further questions, please reply to this message and we'll add it to your enquiry.' It describes a reply-and-attach process that is not established. If a closing line is wanted, use something non-procedural, such as 'If you have further questions in the meantime, please let us know.'
